text: So I've been charting how patients move through our ward and the current picture is a bit of a mess. Intake goes to Triage, and Triage goes to either Ward or Lab. I want the Triage to be a diamond since it's a decision point. Then make the Ward and the Lab side by side, same height, so they line up horizontally. Which of these is connected to the most others? If it's not Triage then something is wrong with my links. Also give Lab a red color, because it's the emergency path. I might need to undo that later though. Oh, and please add a small green circle named Exit to the right of the Ward. Link Ward to it with an arrow, and do the same from Lab. Thanks a lot, you guys are lifesavers.
Landing page again. Place Cta below Hero. Make the Cta a big green rectangle. Is the Hero bigger than the Nav? Move the Nav 30 pixels up.

Genealogy project, I'm tracing four generations and getting lost. is Dad connected to Me? Link Grandpa to Dad, then Dad to Me. Make Grandpa a big gray circle since he's the oldest. Dad is a medium blue circle and Me is a small green circle. Put Grandpa on top, Dad in the middle, and Me at the bottom. Is Grandpa connected to Me directly? Obviously not, but I want to check. Who is connected to Dad? Which one has the most links? Is there any cycle? There better not be. Rename Me to Alex, that's my real name. Good, that is all.
Pub quiz scoreboard, week twelve. Add a new box with the name Round3 and put it to the right of Round2, then connect Round2 to it. Make Round1 gold. Is Round2 bigger than Round1?

Kitchen redesign. I think the Sink looks too small. Can you blow it up a bit? And switch the Oven and the Fridge, my workflow goes right to left. Make the Fridge white. Is the Sink near the Oven? Move the Sink 50 pixels to the right.

Fantasy map for my campaign. Connect Gate to Keep, then Keep to Moat, then Moat back to Gate. Make the Keep a huge gray square. Moat should be blue. Is the Gate reachable from the Keep? Which shape has the most connections? Paint the Gate brown.
Startup org chart, early days. Founder is the biggest one, right? Make the Dev a green circle and the Designer a pink circle. Put the Founder at the top. Link the Founder to the Dev and the Designer.
Science fair poster. Paint all the circles green. And the squares blue. Make the Sun a huge yellow circle. Is the Water connected to the Plant? Connect the Sun to the Plant with an arrow.

Robot arm for the engineering club, and I will explain as I go, sorry. uhh so the Claw should be like a triangle? and sort of small, yeah, and attach it to the Arm. The Base should be a large gray rectangle at the bottom. Put the Arm above the Base. Link the Base to the Arm with a plain line. Make the Arm a long... no, make it a blue rectangle. The Claw is red. Is the Claw connected to the Arm? Is it connected to the Base? Which one is the most connected? Count the connections for me. And tell me what color the Claw is, I might have mixed it up. Rename the Claw to Gripper. Perfect, thank you!

Tournament bracket for the office league. Final is the winner node: connect Teamx and Teamy to it. How many connections is that? Make Final a huge gold star. Teamx is blue and Teamy is red. Is Teamx bigger than Teamy? Put Teamx on the left and Teamy on the right.

Shelter adoption board. Make a pink heart-ish thing... ok a star, a pink star, named Bird, in the top left corner. Make the Dog brown and the Cat gray. How many shapes are on the board now? Is the Cat above the Dog? Link the Dog to the Cat with a dotted line.

Electrician's homework, I need to verify the wiring in order. Is there a way to get from Plug to Lamp? Line up Plug, Fuse and Lamp horizontally. Connect Plug to Fuse and Fuse to Lamp. Make the Fuse red, it's the weak point. Put the Plug on the left, the Fuse in the middle and the Lamp on the right. Is the Fuse bigger than the Lamp? Which of the three is the leftmost? Does the Plug connect directly to the Lamp? What can be reached from the Plug? Delete nothing, I just wanted to look. Shrink the Lamp, it looks too big. Thanks so much, you saved me.

Let me explain what I need. The pipeline for blog posts starts at Draft and ends at Archive, with Review and Publish in between. First stack all four in a column so the order reads top to bottom. Then I want a dashed arrow between each consecutive pair, Draft to Review, Review to Publish and Publish to Archive. Archive should look dull, so make it gray. And Publish should look important, so make it gold and large. Can you tell me whether Review is smaller than Publish now? One more question, what is directly connected to Review? Please also put Draft to the back, I like it partially hidden. Oh, and move Draft 40 pixels to the left. That is everything.
Maze level, third draft. Pls move the Exit way up, like 150 pixels. Make the Entry green and the Exit red. Is the Entry connected to the Exit? Not yet. Link them with a dashed line.
Song structure diagram. Chorus goes in the middle between Verse and Bridge. Make the Chorus a big gold star. Link Verse, Chorus and Bridge in a chain. Is the Bridge smaller than the Verse?
Put all four desks in a grid. Honestly I keep changing my mind, so maybe a row. No, grid, final answer.
Dog show chart. whats Rex's color. And what shape is Rex? Make Rex big.

Network sketch for the helpdesk. The Client is blue and the Server is red. And is the Gateway a hexagon? Link the Client to the Gateway and the Gateway to the Server. Is the Server reachable from the Client? Make the Gateway big.
Library inventory. Duplicate Books three times and rename the Shelf to Rack. Make Books a gold square. Is the Shelf near the Books?

Airport ground map. The tower must be near Gate1. Move Gate2 100 pixels to the right so there is space. Make the Tower a huge navy hexagon. Gate1 should be green. Is Gate2 left of Gate1? Link the Tower to both gates.

Alright, deep breath. I am planning my thesis and the Core is my main research question. I need five branches coming off it, so create five small circles around the Core. Then I will name them one at a time. For now give me the first one labelled Methods. Hmm, scratch that, label it Theory. Is there something above the Core? I would like to see everything that is near it. Next, make the Core huge and color it indigo. If the circles look crowded I will ask you to arrange them in a circle later. Thank you, I really appreciate the help.
Logistics map for the warehouse. send the Truck from the Depot to the Store, I mean draw the link. Make the Truck a blue rectangle. Put the Store on the right. Is the Depot connected to the Truck?

Bakery workflow. Put the Oven at the far right and the Dough at the far left. Then Bread goes in the center. Make the Bread brown and the Dough white. Link Dough to Oven and Oven to Bread. Is the Dough reachable from the Bread?
Infra review, I am a bit rusty. list the shapes that are not red. Make the Db a large red rectangle. Connect Lb to Web1 and Web2. Link Web1 and Web2 to Db. How many connections do we have?
Quiz layout. which shape is closest to Q1? Move Q2 100 pixels down. Make Q1 a big pink circle.
hello! can you hear me? i'm just testing this thing

Decision tree for the hiring flow. Root splits into Yes and No, so link it to both. The Yes one should be green and No one red, obviously. Put the Root at the top. Is the Yes node connected to the Root? Which one has the most links? Make the Root a diamond.
Class schedule board. Remove every shape that isn't green. Make Math green and Art red. Is Music green? Count the green shapes.
Aquarium design. Make the Fish much larger. Wait, actualy just a bit larger, it's fine. Make the Reef a huge brown rectangle. Move the Fish near the Reef. Is the Fish smaller than the Reef?

We're redesigning the ground floor and I'd like some help placing things. The Hall is the center of everything, so move it to the center of the canvas. Room1 and Room2 go left and right of the Hall. Room3 goes above it. Then let the Stair sit between Room1 and Room2, hmm no that's the same spot as the Hall, put it below the Hall. Make the three rooms squares if they are not already. Link the Hall to each room with a line without arrows. Is there any room that isn't linked to the Hall? Also make the Hall huge, it's the biggest space. Then tell me how many squares we have. Good.

Funnel diagram for the marketing deck. Lead is a circle, Trial is a diamond and Customer is a star. Just stating the setup. Now connect Lead to Trial and Trial to Customer. Make Customer gold. Is the Lead connected to the Customer? Put the Lead on the left and the Customer on the right.
CDN diagram. Connect Cache and Origin both ways. Make the Cache a small orange circle. Origin should be a large gray rectangle. Is the Origin bigger than the Cache?
Board game design, prototype one. Create 3 tiny red squares near Start. Put the Goal at the bottom right. Make the Start green. Is the Goal reachable from the Start? Link them if not.
Civics class. Which one is the leftmost? Make the Senate blue and the House red. Is the House bigger than the Senate? Put the Senate on the left.
Circuit layout, quick questions. Is R1 left of R2? Is it also above C1? Put R1 to the left of R2. Make C1 a tiny gray circle. Link R1 and R2 to C1.

Garden bed plan for spring. Rose, Tulip and Lily should be pink, purple and yellow. And the Daisy white. Link Rose to Tulip. Put Daisy near the Lily. Is the Daisy white yet? Make the Rose a big circle. Which flower is the leftmost? How many shapes do we have? Tulip should be a hexagon, just for fun. Delete nothing though. Is Tulip bigger than Lily? Thanks!
DevOps diagram for the wiki. I'd like Git to feed Ci and Ci to feed Prod. Make Prod a big red hexagon. Ci is orange and Git is gray. Is Prod reachable from Git? Which one has the most connections?
Anatomy diagram, ignore my drawing skills. Disconnect the Heart from the Lung. Make the Heart red and the Lung blue. Link the Heart to the Lung with a dashed line. Is the Heart connected to the Lung?

Data science project layout. OK so the first step: mean the Raw data. Not mean, I meant move the Raw to the top left. Clean goes under it. Model and Report go next to each other under Clean. Does Raw connect to Clean? If not, link them with a solid arrow. Make Raw a gray circle and Clean a lime circle. Model should be a blue hexagon. Report is a gold star. Link Clean to Model and Clean to Report. Which shape has the most connections? Is Report reachable from Raw? Rename Report to Dashboard. That should do it for now.

Commute map. The shortest way from Home to Gym passes through Work, right? Just show me the route. Make Work a big blue square. Home is green and Gym is orange. Link Home to Work and Work to Gym. Which one is the rightmost?

Theatre floor plan. Put the Stage on top of the Seats ... I mean in front of the Seats, bring it to front. Make the Seats a huge red rectangle. The Wings should be small and gray. Is the Stage above the Seats?
Tiny test. Swap A and B. Make A red and B blue.

Zoo keeper's board. ok so ape and bird should be the same height, so line them up, and fish and snake too. Use a horizontal line for that. Make the Ape brown, the Bird yellow, the Fish blue and the Snake green. Is the Snake near the Fish?

Compiler design notes for my course project. I need the Lexer to point to the Parser, and the Parser to the Ast. Then get me everything reachable from Lexer. Make the Lexer a small green circle. The Parser should be a large blue rectangle. Ast is a gold star. Put the Lexer on the left, the Parser in the middle and the Ast on the right. Is the Ast reachable from the Lexer? Which shape has the most connections? Is the Lexer bigger than the Parser? What is the degree of the Parser? Rename the Ast to Tree. Delete nothing. Thanks, exam is tomorrow.

Org chart for the small office. The boss is red. Always. From now on make every new square red as well. Make the Boss big. Add a blue circle called Intern below the Boss. Connect the Boss to the Intern.
Put the Mole in a different hole. I mean move it left 80 pixels, onto Hole1. Then tell me what color Hole1 is.
Trip planner. Hmm what does the diagram look like right now. Make Paris a gold star. Is Rome bigger than Berlin?
Let's set the Coil to large. And the Magnet to huge. Is the Magnet bigger than the Coil? Surely it is.

River map for the geography test. Create a big blue ellipse named Lake between Source and Delta. Make the Source a small blue circle and the Delta a big green one. Link the Source to the Delta. Is the Lake connected to the Delta?
Wish list board. Draw a medium magenta hexagon, label it "Top Pick", please. Is it a hexagon? I want to be sure. How many hexagons are there?
